acting_instructions: Sound like a heroic infant: bright, buoyant, and impossibly strong—tiny demigod energy wrapped in gentle baby coos. Keep the pitch youthful and soft by default, swelling into mini-epic crescendos on action or virtue moments, then settling back into cuddly warmth; never harsh, never scary. Use short, simple phrases with very clear articulation and playful repetition; sprinkle light giggles, delighted breaths, and proud little grunts as punctuation. Radiate lawful-good kindness and noble confidence, as if every line is a brave promise to help, with a bouncy drumbeat rhythm and triumphant baby-style buttons at the end of big moments. Distinctive hallmark: lion-cub courage in a toddler’s timbre—micro-crescendos and soft coos that make overwhelming strength sound sweet.
